result.title: Juror response
result.content: I vote guilty, crediting Mira’s attributed account that “I saw Fictional Rowan hand a blue token to Fictional Ellis at the desk” (E-001). Tavi’s attributed account says “I did not see a handover” and separately states “Fictional Rowan left with the blue token still in their hand” (E-002); I find no reasonable doubt about the listed condition.

jurors.rationale: My low-skepticism, evidence-led approach gives E-001 greater weight because it attributes a direct observation of the required details. E-002 says “I did not see a handover” and separately narrates departure; it does not establish uninterrupted possession or directly contradict receipt.
